rejected.reason: September start only for on-campus grados. All 246 degree pages in the official degree sitemaps (67 EN + 179 ES) were downloaded on 2026-10-04: every on-campus grado shows 'Start/Inicio: 14 sep 2026 / septiembre 2026 / 13 sep 2027' (e.g. Computer Engineering in English: 'Classes in English or Spanish ... Start: 14 sep. 2026'). The only February start on the site is for ONLINE grados ('Start dates: February and September', online modality, so no student visa = rejected). The 'February intake' in the brief comes from aggregators (gogoespana, etc.), not from UE. Open point: the official reservation-discount T&Cs (Oct 2026) say 'The 50% discount on place reservations for undergraduate programmes also applies to those enrolled this month for S2', i.e. there is some second-semester (S2) undergraduate intake, but no campus-based grado page names it. Worth one email to UE admissions to ask which on-campus English grados, if any, take S2 (Feb 2027) entrants.

CUNEF's own news says the 1,260 new students joined at the start of the 2026-27 academic year (September). No 'inicio en febrero' or spring entry for new degree students on any official page; spring entry is for exchange students only. Confirm by email if needed.

NOT VERIFIED. Every ucjc.edu (and sek.es/ucjc) URL returns a SiteGround 'Robot Challenge Screen' (HTTP 202) to automated fetching, including the official fee PDF 'Honorarios Académicos de Grados 2026-27' and the 'Curso 2026-2027' calendar page. The challenge was not bypassed, and the Wayback Machine returned HTTP 429. No official evidence of a February start for NEW grado students was obtained. Aggregator claims of a 'Spring Intake beginning in February' appear to describe study-abroad/exchange entry. A search-engine snippet of the official fee PDF says the first monthly payment falls 'in the month the degree program begins', which is inconclusive. Action: check the two URLs below in a normal browser, or email UCJC admissions.

notes: Result for this group: no on-campus OFFICIAL grado taught in English (or any language) with a January/February 2027 start for NEW full-degree students was confirmed at Universidad Europea, IE University, Nebrija, ESIC, UAX, U-tad, CUNEF or Universidad Villanueva, so 'programs' is empty. Method: full crawls of the official degree sitemaps/pages (UE 246 pages, ESIC 23, UAX 39, U-tad 89, Villanueva 34, CUNEF all grado pages), grepping the 'Start/Inicio' fields and any febrero/February/enero/January text. Key nuances: (1) Universidad Europea: February starts exist only for ONLINE grados (no visa). Its October 2026 reservation-discount T&Cs mention an undergraduate 'S2' (second-semester) enrolment, but no on-campus grado page shows an S2/Feb start. This is the single lead worth one email to UE admissions (Madrid admissions phone +34 918257503, shown on the site) asking whether any campus-based English grado admits S2 entrants in Feb 2027. (2) IE University: September intake only. Rounds for Sept 2027 are Early 18 Sep 2026, R1 6 Nov 2026 (decision by 11 Dec 2026), R2 15 Jan 2027, R3 5 Mar 2027. Tuition 2026-27: BBA EUR 29,880 and CS&AI EUR 27,300 per year (first year). Visa contact iestudentservices@ie.edu. (3) Nebrija now has a 100% English official 'Bachelor in Business and Technology' (from 2026-27, 45 places), September start only. (4) U-tad's Grado en Ingeniería del Software can be taken 100% in English, September start only, enrolment 1 May-30 Sep. (5) UCJC and ESNE could not be verified: UCJC's site sits behind a bot challenge that was not circumvented, and ESNE's site failed TLS/503. Treat them as unverified, check manually in a browser, and do not treat them as confirmed Feb options. (6) In every institution here, February entry is for exchange/study-abroad students only (e.g. Nebrija fact sheet, UE study-abroad semesters Feb-June), which the spec excludes. Session constraint: the shared WebSearch budget (200 calls) ran out mid-task, so later checks used direct official-site downloads only.
